purpose: Test all leakage-safe historically reconstructable Quick Evidence families together in one regularized offset rather than relying only on separate component screens.

asOfPolicy.missingFeaturePolicy: zero only when the source family is known to be observable and the member/event has no qualifying evidence; otherwise use an explicit availability indicator or exclude the family under the frozen source boundary

excludedFromPrimaryHistoricalFit.reason: ordinary transaction dates do not prove historical filing/public availability at the target forecast cutoff
the present-day crawler does not provide a broad outcome-blind historical capture process for 2021-2024
no broad frozen historical acquisition corpus exists across the replay universe; selected or surviving present-day pages would create an inconsistent historical source boundary
historical source coverage is not complete enough to treat absence as an interpretable zero in the primary combined fit

transform.continuousFeatures: training-session standardization with parameters frozen and applied unchanged to validation/descriptive
transform.missingContinuousFeatures: 0 after standardization plus retained availability indicator

fit.model: multivariable ridge logistic offset on serving Quick logit
selectionMetricOrder: validation chamber mean absolute yes-vote error

requiredSlices: member outcomes with at least one nonzero combined feature
member outcomes whose candidate probability moves
reporting.componentAblations: report leave-one-family-out deltas after the primary combined fit without using them to retune or select the primary model

interpretation.note: A positive historical result can justify prospective measurement or a separately frozen future promotion protocol, but cannot change serving Quick by itself.
